external_datasets.title: CALB generation 3b 58 Ah: harvested half-cell OCP, multi-temperature tests and ageing
external_datasets.cell_identity: CALB generation 3b 58 Ah prismatic NMC532/graphite. Half-cell donor Cell_96; characterization Cell_4/6/15; 41 ageing cells. Exact commercial part is not supplied; do not equate this with L148N58A by capacity/dimensions alone.
external_datasets.rate_summary: Full-cell CC, GITT, dynamic cycles and HPPC plus calendar/cyclic ageing. Characterization EIS source labels: 0/5/25/45 degC. No complete same-state continuous rate-sweep matrix was checked.

channels.note: Source-documented fields only. Time starts with one absolute timestamp, followed by incremental seconds; cumulative reconstruction is required. Characterization header has trailing whitespace. Source reports sub-second increments and isolated voltage spikes. Half-cell CSVs, time units, EIS segmentation and actual headers remain unread.

license.note: Primary metadata explicitly states CC BY 4.0 for data. Separate author analysis code is MIT. Only metadata and external links are packaged.

review.note: Complete 2_HalfCell, 3_Characterization and 4_Ageing 7z directories inspected with py7zr 1.1.0 via bounded HTTP ranges. Only 520/1405/7333 metadata bytes read respectively; no member extracted. Source/documented counts and directory counts are kept separate. Follow-up: selected half-cell/parameter originals were read, pinned and extracted by scripts/seed_parameter_sources.py. Full-cell observation payloads remain unread and external.

parameter_link.evidence: Native extracted OCP/parameter records and external full-cell tests are linked by explicit study/model identity. No identical serialized specimen is asserted.
